title: Glowing cactus in a pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7dffb0' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7dffb0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='potGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9a5c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d95f2b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cactusGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6bffa8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2ecf74'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='armGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5bf29a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#28b862'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- pot saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#ffb88a'/>

  <!-- pot -->
  <path d='M26 68 L32 84 L68 84 L74 68 Z' fill='url(#potGrad)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='64' width='52' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ffb07a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffc49e' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#8b5a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65.5' rx='20' ry='3' fill='#a86e4a'/>

  <!-- main cactus body -->
  <rect x='42' y='28' width='16' height='40' rx='8' fill='url(#cactusGrad)'/>
  <rect x='45' y='32' width='4' height='30' rx='2' fill='#8affc0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- left arm -->
  <path d='M42 48 L34 48 Q30 48 30 44 L30 38 Q30 34 34 34 L36 34' fill='none' stroke='url(#armGrad)' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm highlight -->
  <path d='M42 48 L34 48 Q30 48 30 44 L30 38 Q30 34 34 34 L36 34' fill='none' stroke='#8affc0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M58 52 L66 52 Q70 52 70 48 L70 42 Q70 38 66 38 L64 38' fill='none' stroke='url(#armGrad)' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm highlight -->
  <path d='M58 52 L66 52 Q70 52 70 48 L70 42 Q70 38 66 38 L64 38' fill='none' stroke='#8affc0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- cactus spines -->
  <g stroke='#c8ffe0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='42' y1='36' x2='38' y2='34'/>
    <line x1='42' y1='42' x2='38' y2='41'/>
    <line x1='42' y1='50' x2='38' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='42' y1='58' x2='38' y2='59'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='36' x2='62' y2='34'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='44' x2='62' y2='44'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='52' x2='62' y2='53'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='60' x2='62' y2='61'/>
  </g>

  <!-- cactus flower on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='5' fill='#ff6fa8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#ffd14d'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fc0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fc0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='21.5' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fc0'/>

  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <g fill='#eaffef'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='58' r='1.5' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='60' r='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='1.2' opacity='0.6'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='34' r='1.2' opacity='0.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='1.8' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='48' r='1' opacity='0.5'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='44' r='1' opacity='0.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
